note: The library the labeled queries in api/eval/search-v1.json are judged against. Invented content, no real user data. The field names match embed.Fields, because what a reel is findable by is exactly what the embedding document is built from. saved_at is a fixed date so a date-filter query can be checked in without going stale. Note which fields reach which arm: the full-text column is built from title, summary and caption only, so tags, key facts, places and category are reachable by the vector arm alone.

reels.title: Artjuna cafe
reels.summary: A quiet garden cafe in Anjuna with strong coffee and long tables under the trees.
reels.caption: the garden seating stays quiet even at noon
facts: the coffee here is the reason to come
reels.transcript: we came for the coffee and stayed all afternoon under the trees

reels.title: Garden bistro tasting
reels.summary: A garden bistro where the chef walks you through the menu. Good coffee, slow afternoons.
reels.caption: quiet garden tables at the back
facts: the chef recommends starting with the soup
reels.transcript: the chef came out between courses and told us what to order next

reels.title: Three days in north Goa
reels.summary: A long vlog covering beaches, markets and a sunset stop.
reels.caption: three days, one scooter
facts: the bakery opens at six in the morning and sells out by nine
reels.transcript: day one we rode north, day two the markets, day three we watched the sunset from the cliff

reels.title: Chapora fort at sunset
reels.summary: The best sunset viewpoint in north Goa, a ten minute walk up.
reels.caption: climb up before six
facts: the climb takes ten minutes from the road
reels.transcript: the light goes fast so start climbing well before sunset

reels.title: Dudhsagar trek guide
reels.summary: A full day trek to the waterfall, what to carry and when to start.
reels.caption: a full day on foot
facts: the trek takes about five hours each way
reels.transcript: carry more water than you think and start before it gets hot

reels.title: Mumbai street food crawl
reels.summary: Vada pav, pav bhaji and kulfi across five stops.
reels.caption: five stops, one evening
facts: the last stop is the kulfi place near the station
reels.transcript: start at the vada pav stall and work your way down the street

reels.title: Standing sushi counter in Tsukiji
reels.summary: A ten seat counter where you eat standing up and pay by the piece. No reservations, no menu.
reels.caption: eight pieces, twelve minutes, gone
facts: cash only, no cards
the queue is shortest at eleven in the morning
reels.transcript: you stand, you eat, you leave, that is the whole idea

reels.title: Walking Yanaka, old Tokyo
reels.summary: A slow walk through a neighbourhood the war and the developers both missed. Wooden houses, a long cemetery path, cats.
reels.caption: one afternoon, no plan
facts: the shopping street closes on Mondays
the cemetery path is the quietest way through
reels.transcript: nothing here is a sight, that is why it is worth the afternoon

reels.title: How the Tokyo train card actually works
reels.summary: Buying, topping up and returning a transit card, and which trains it does not cover.
reels.caption: the card is the easy part
facts: the deposit is five hundred yen and you get it back at the counter
the card does not cover the airport express
reels.transcript: tap in, tap out, and top up before the gate not after

reels.title: Kyoto temple before the crowds
reels.summary: Getting to the hillside temple at opening time, when the walk up is empty and the light is low.
reels.caption: six in the morning, nobody else
facts: the gate opens at six and the tour buses arrive at nine
reels.transcript: if you are there at six you have the whole hill to yourself

reels.title: Kushikatsu rules in Osaka
reels.summary: Fried skewers, one shared sauce pot, and the one rule everybody breaks.
reels.caption: do not double dip
facts: you may not dip a skewer twice, the sauce is shared
the cabbage on the counter is free and is meant as a scoop
reels.transcript: one dip only, that is the rule and they will tell you

reels.title: Seoul after midnight
reels.summary: Where to eat when everything else is shut: tent bars, a fish market kitchen and a bakery that opens at three.
reels.caption: the city does not close
facts: the fish market stalls will cook what you buy for a small fee
reels.transcript: buy it downstairs, carry it upstairs, they cook it and charge you for the table

reels.title: Renting a hanbok for the palace
reels.summary: What a rental costs, how long you get it for, and why it gets you in free.
reels.caption: free entry if you are wearing one
facts: wearing a rented hanbok gets you into the palace with no ticket
four hours is the standard rental block
reels.transcript: the rental pays for itself because the ticket is free while you wear it

reels.title: Boat noodles by the canal
reels.summary: Tiny bowls, four to a person, eaten fast at a canal-side stall. The stack of empty bowls is the bill.
reels.caption: eleven bowls between two of us
facts: they count your empty bowls to work out the bill
one bowl is two mouthfuls, order four to start
reels.transcript: keep the bowls stacked, that is how they know what you owe

reels.title: The river ferry beats the traffic
reels.summary: Using the orange flag boat instead of a taxi, where it stops and what it costs.
reels.caption: twenty minutes instead of an hour
facts: the orange flag boat is the cheap local one and stops everywhere
the tourist blue flag boat costs four times as much
reels.transcript: look at the flag on the back of the boat before you get on

reels.title: Egg coffee up a staircase
reels.summary: A cafe you reach through a shop and up three flights. Whipped yolk over strong coffee, served hot in a water bath.
reels.caption: walk through the shop, keep going up
facts: the entrance is through a silk shop with no sign of its own
reels.transcript: there is no sign, you just walk through the shop and up the stairs

reels.title: Train street timing
reels.summary: The narrow lane the train runs through twice a day, and when the cafes move the chairs.
reels.caption: chairs in, train past, chairs out
facts: the train passes at seven twenty in the evening on weekdays
reels.transcript: everyone pulls the chairs in about five minutes before it comes

reels.title: Reading a hawker centre
reels.summary: How the stalls are laid out, why the queue length is the only review you need, and what tissue packets on a table mean.
reels.caption: the packet means the table is taken
facts: a packet of tissues left on a table means it is reserved
the stalls with the longest queues open earliest and sell out
reels.transcript: never move the tissues, that table belongs to somebody

reels.title: Filter coffee at a standing counter
reels.summary: A seventy year old counter in Basavanagudi, coffee in a steel tumbler, no seats and no card machine.
reels.caption: steel tumbler, four minutes, out
facts: cash only
they stop serving between three and four
reels.transcript: you drink it standing and you drink it fast

reels.title: Benne dosa queue
reels.summary: Butter dosa from a stall with a permanent line down the pavement. Order at the till first, then join the second queue.
reels.caption: two queues, one dosa
facts: pay at the till first and carry the token to the counter
they run out of the butter dosa by half past ten
reels.transcript: pay first, then queue again, that is just how it works

reels.title: Cubbon Park on a car free Sunday
reels.summary: The park closes to traffic on Sundays. Readers, skaters, dogs and a small book market under the trees.
reels.caption: no cars, all morning
facts: the roads through the park are shut to cars on Sunday mornings
reels.transcript: on a sunday the road through the middle belongs to everybody

reels.title: Thrift market on Commercial Street
reels.summary: Second hand denim and jackets sold by weight from open stalls. Bargaining expected, changing rooms not provided.
reels.caption: sold by the kilo
facts: the denim stalls price by weight, not by item
the market thins out badly after four in the afternoon
reels.transcript: they weigh it, that is the price, and then you argue about it

reels.title: Delhi airport line, start to finish
reels.summary: The express metro from the airport into town, which terminal it serves and where you change for the rest of the network.
reels.caption: twenty minutes to the middle
facts: the express line only serves terminal three
the last train leaves the airport at eleven at night
reels.transcript: if you land at terminal one you have to shuttle across first

reels.title: Renting a scooter in Goa without getting stung
reels.summary: What paperwork to ask for, what the deposit should be, and the damage argument that happens on the way back.
reels.caption: photograph every scratch first
facts: photograph every existing scratch before you ride off
an international driving permit is what the police ask for
reels.transcript: take pictures of the whole bike before you leave, every single time

reels.title: Cycling in Amsterdam without being hated
reels.summary: Which lane is yours, how the hand signals work, and where not to leave the bike.
reels.caption: stay right, signal early
facts: a bike left outside the marked racks near the station gets removed
the red asphalt lane is for bikes and mopeds both
reels.transcript: the red lane is not a pavement, do not walk in it

reels.title: An old brown cafe on a canal
reels.summary: Dark wood, sand on the floor, small tables by the window. Beer and cheese, nothing else.
reels.caption: same room since 1890
facts: the sand on the floor is original and gets swept out each night
reels.transcript: the floor has had sand on it since before anybody here was born

reels.title: Is the museum card worth it
reels.summary: Working out how many visits it takes to break even, and which museums are excluded.
reels.caption: five visits and it pays
facts: the card breaks even at five museum visits
the Anne Frank house is not included
reels.transcript: count your museums first, five is the number

reels.title: Tram 28 from the wrong end
reels.summary: Boarding at the quiet terminus instead of the crowded one so you get a seat for the whole route.
reels.caption: start at the end nobody uses
facts: boarding at the eastern terminus gets you a seat, the western one never does
reels.transcript: everybody queues at the famous end, go to the other one

reels.title: Custard tarts straight from the oven
reels.summary: A bakery that sells them warm all day. Cinnamon on top is optional and locals skip it.
reels.caption: warm or nothing
facts: a fresh batch comes out roughly every twenty minutes
reels.transcript: wait for the tray, do not take one off the shelf

reels.title: The viewpoint with the least stairs
reels.summary: A terrace over the old town you can reach by lift instead of climbing. Best about an hour before dark.
reels.caption: take the lift, not the hill
facts: a public lift goes up from the lower street and costs the price of a bus ticket
reels.transcript: there is a lift, you do not have to walk up any of it

reels.title: Port cellar tour across the river
reels.summary: The cellars are in the town on the other bank, not in Porto itself. A tasting is included and you walk back over the bridge.
reels.caption: wrong side of the river on purpose
facts: the cellars are all in Vila Nova de Gaia, across the bridge from Porto
reels.transcript: you cross the bridge, that is where all of them are

reels.title: Sunday flea market in Mauerpark
reels.summary: Records, old cameras, furniture and a lot of junk. Cash, early, and haggle in the last hour.
reels.caption: bring cash, come early
facts: most stalls take cash only
prices drop hard in the last hour before packing up
reels.transcript: the last hour is when they would rather sell it than carry it home

reels.title: The doner queue that is worth it
reels.summary: Grilled vegetables, three sauces and a queue that runs forty minutes at lunch.
reels.caption: forty minutes, still worth it
facts: the queue is shortest right at opening, before eleven
reels.transcript: come at opening or accept that you are standing there for a while

reels.title: Everything is shut on Sunday
reels.summary: Shops close by law. What stays open, and where to buy food on a Saturday night instead.
reels.caption: plan your Saturday
facts: supermarkets inside main stations stay open on Sundays
shop closing is national law, not a local choice
reels.transcript: the station shops are the loophole, they are allowed to open

reels.title: Buying bread like you live there
reels.summary: What to ask for, why the baker asks how you want it cut, and the day the bakery is shut.
reels.caption: ask for it well baked
facts: most neighbourhood bakeries close one weekday, usually Monday
asking for it well baked is normal and free
reels.transcript: you can ask for it darker, nobody minds, everyone does it

reels.title: The tip of the island at eight
reels.summary: A stone point at the end of the island where people sit with wine and watch the river.
reels.caption: bring a bottle and sit down
facts: drinking outdoors here is tolerated but glass gets you moved on some nights
reels.transcript: everyone sits on the stone at the end and nobody bothers you

reels.title: Vermouth hour before lunch
reels.summary: A midday drink with olives and crisps, standing at a marble counter. Over by two.
reels.caption: noon until two, then it stops
facts: the vermouth hour runs from about noon to two and then the bar switches to lunch
reels.transcript: if you turn up at three you have missed it entirely

reels.title: Old anti aircraft platform over the city
reels.summary: Concrete platforms on a hill with the whole city below. A steep twenty minutes up from the bus stop.
reels.caption: steep, and worth it
facts: a warden clears the platforms at half past nine in summer
reels.transcript: they do move everyone on at night now, so go earlier

reels.title: Breakfast on the Asian side
reels.summary: Take the ferry across, eat a long table breakfast in a side street, walk back to the pier.
reels.caption: twenty minutes on the water
facts: the ferry runs every twenty minutes and takes a transit card
reels.transcript: the boat is the best part of the meal honestly

reels.title: Bargaining in the covered market
reels.summary: How the first price works, when to walk, and which gates take you back out.
reels.caption: the first price is never the price
facts: the opening price is usually about three times what the seller expects
reels.transcript: walk away once, that is the whole technique

reels.title: Drinking from the street fountains
reels.summary: The little iron spouts all over the city run cold and free. Block the end with a finger and it arcs upward.
reels.caption: free, cold, everywhere
facts: blocking the spout with a finger sends the water up out of a hole on top so you can drink from it
reels.transcript: put your finger over the end and it comes out of the top

reels.title: The market where Rome eats lunch
reels.summary: A covered produce market with a handful of counters at the back doing sandwiches and offal.
reels.caption: go to the back, not the front
facts: the food counters are at the back and stop serving at two
reels.transcript: the front is vegetables, the back is where you eat

reels.title: Museum late opening on Fridays
reels.summary: The big museums stay open into the evening one night a week, with a bar in the hall and no school groups.
reels.caption: same rooms, half the people
facts: Friday is the late night and the permanent collection is still free
reels.transcript: it is the same museum with about a fifth of the people in it

reels.title: Do not buy a travel card
reels.summary: Tapping a bank card is capped at the same daily price, so the paper card is a waste of the deposit.
reels.caption: just tap your bank card
facts: contactless payment hits the same daily cap as the transit card
using two different cards in one day breaks the cap
reels.transcript: tap the same card every time or the cap does not apply

reels.title: Swimming in the harbour
reels.summary: Cleaned up enough to swim in, with wooden platforms and lifeguards in summer. Free.
reels.caption: clean enough to swim, really
facts: the harbour baths are free and staffed with lifeguards from June to August
reels.transcript: people swim right in the middle of the city and it is completely normal

reels.title: The hot dog stand with the queue
reels.summary: One stand, one order, crispy onions underneath and remoulade on top.
reels.caption: ask for one with everything
facts: ordering it with everything gets you raw and fried onion plus three sauces
reels.transcript: just say one with everything, that is the whole order

reels.title: Ring road in seven days
reels.summary: A full loop of the island by car, where the long driving days are and which stretch to do first.
reels.caption: seven days, one loop
facts: the eastern fjords are the longest driving day at about six hours
gravel roads are not covered by standard rental insurance
reels.transcript: do the south first, it is the busiest and you want it out of the way

reels.title: Al pastor from the spit
reels.summary: The cone of pork by the door, a slice of pineapple flicked on top, four to an order.
reels.caption: watch the pineapple land
facts: the spit only comes out in the evening, do not go looking at lunchtime
reels.transcript: if the cone is not up it is not worth stopping

reels.title: Seven moles in one market
reels.summary: A market hall selling mole pastes by the scoop, each a different colour, plus a smoke-filled meat aisle.
reels.caption: buy the paste, not the jar
facts: the paste keeps for months and travels better than the finished sauce
reels.transcript: get the paste, it is what everyone here actually cooks with

reels.title: Weekend subway changes
reels.summary: Lines reroute at weekends and the app is not always right. Read the paper notice on the pillar.
reels.caption: read the poster on the pillar
facts: weekend service changes are posted on paper at the station before they reach the apps
reels.transcript: the printed notice is usually more current than your phone

reels.title: Ordering a bagel without holding up the line
reels.summary: Know the bagel, the spread and whether it is toasted before you reach the counter.
reels.caption: say it all in one go
facts: a good bagel is not toasted, toasting is what you do to yesterday's
reels.transcript: if it is fresh you do not toast it, that is the rule

reels.title: Ceviche is a lunch dish
reels.summary: The fish comes in that morning, so the good places stop serving in the afternoon and shut.
reels.caption: gone by four
facts: a ceviche place serving at night is working with yesterday's fish
reels.transcript: nobody serious sells it in the evening, the fish is a morning thing

reels.title: Table Mountain in a cloud
reels.summary: The cable car shuts when the wind is up, and the cloth of cloud over the top is the warning sign.
reels.caption: check the wind, not the forecast
facts: the cable car closes for wind more often than for rain
tickets bought online are refunded if the car is shut
reels.transcript: if there is cloud pouring over the edge it is not running

reels.title: Booking a riad in the old town
reels.summary: Courtyard houses inside the walls. Cars cannot reach the door, so someone meets you with a cart.
reels.caption: the taxi stops at the wall
facts: taxis cannot enter the old town, the riad sends someone with a cart for the bags
reels.transcript: they meet you at the gate because there is no road to the door

reels.title: Two weeks in a carry on
reels.summary: A packing method built around one pair of shoes and washing things in a sink.
reels.caption: one bag, no exceptions
facts: merino wool can be worn several days and dries overnight
rolling saves space, folding saves creases, and you cannot have both
reels.transcript: the shoes are the thing that decides the size of your bag

reels.title: Getting data abroad without a shop visit
reels.summary: Installing a digital sim before you land, keeping your number for messages, and which phones cannot do it.
reels.caption: install it before you fly
facts: install the profile while you still have wifi, it cannot be added once you land without a connection
reels.transcript: do it at home, you cannot install it without internet and you have no internet yet

reels.title: Night shots on a phone
reels.summary: Brace against something solid, drop the exposure, and stop trying to zoom.
reels.caption: lean on a wall
facts: pulling the exposure down is what stops street lights blowing out
reels.transcript: find a wall, lean on it, and pull the brightness slider down

reels.title: Sharpening a kitchen knife on a stone
reels.summary: Holding the angle, which grit to start on, and how to tell when the edge has turned.
reels.caption: feel for the burr
facts: the burr along the back of the edge is how you know the side is done
reels.transcript: run your thumb across the back, not along it, and you will feel the burr

reels.title: Starter from flour and water
reels.summary: Two weeks of feeding, what the smell should be at each stage, and when it is ready to bake with.
reels.caption: day nine is when it wakes up
facts: it is ready when it doubles within four hours of a feed
reels.transcript: it smells like nail varnish around day four and that is fine

reels.title: Buying running shoes that fit
reels.summary: Sizing up, checking the width at the front, and why you shop in the evening.
reels.caption: your feet are bigger at six pm
facts: feet swell during the day, so an evening fitting is the honest one
leave a thumb width at the front
reels.transcript: go at the end of the day, your feet are not the same size in the morning

reels.title: Buying a used camera body
reels.summary: Checking the shutter count, looking for sensor marks, and what a fair price looks like.
reels.caption: ask for the shutter count first
facts: a shutter count over a hundred and fifty thousand is where the price should drop hard
reels.transcript: the shutter count is the mileage, ask for it before anything else
